description:
Get chatbot statistics

Returns the lifetime aggregate metrics of one chatbot: session counts, durations, cost, token consumption and quality scores. The figures are read live from the conversation records and count a chat session and a spoken widget conversation alike, so the fields are named after calls even though most entries are chat sessions; the two call-length extremes tracked for voice agents are absent. Cost is in USD, as the voice engine reports it. A chatbot with no recorded activity yet answers 200 with `stats` set to null. A chatbot that does not belong to the calling account answers 404, the same as one that does not exist; a path segment that is not a number answers 400.
name: get_chatbot_analytics
title: Get chatbot statistics
